description:
PR 1 completion gate for the three-PR labeling plan.

## Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add
Review this PR's implemented scope, fix findings, run coverage-upper after review approval, then final mix precommit before final human approval. Record deployment/migration compatibility and obtain separate Git authorization before merge. Files: changed source/tests and owning guides in this PR; validation receipts in Beadwork.

## Tests to add before implementation
Each implementation issue runs mix q and isolated relevant tests. This gate runs fresh required coverage and final checks; fixes receive targeted regression tests.

## Branches/paths validated
PR 1 supports manual document labeling without automation or chunk preview. Automatic controls and reset-to-automatic remain disabled server-side and in UI.

## Mocking plan
Real application boundaries; only external provider/conversion/embedding fixtures as applicable. No mocks for review-only work.

## Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content
Update relevant service/component guides alongside code and record this PR's remaining feature scenarios. Page stays aligned.

## Action reuse assessment
Not applicable: review and validation gate adds no executable operation. Recheck implementation reuse evidence.

## Feature E2E and approval tracking
Persistent feature E2E is zaq-kw0.16, gated by completed-feature UX approval zaq-kw0.15 in PR 3. Earlier PRs retain immediate unit/integration/LiveView coverage and explicitly record deferred E2E scope. No new feature browser tests before that approval. Apply docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md multi-PR validation lifecycle; downstream PR implementation is not a prerequisite for this gate.

## Existing ZAQ patterns and reuse requirements
Reuse acceptance: verify the catalog follows Teams management, editing follows the Share modal staging flow, and forms use appropriate shared result handling and current design-system components. If any shared component/helper is extended, run its existing consumer tests as well as label tests; preserve Teams, Roles and Share behavior. No unrelated legacy UI migration.
Inspect Storybook and public component contracts before implementation. New UI uses current DesignSystem primitives and BOModal. Preserve existing consumers and add regression coverage for any shared extension. No unrelated legacy UI migration. Keep label persistence/authorization in its owning domain; cross-service BO calls use NodeRouter Events.

comments.text: Self-review (PR-review skill) initial verdict: request changes. One high inline finding in ResourceLabels.visible_documents: DocumentAccess.list_permitted_document_ids filters principals but does not check read rights, so a matching update-only grant can expose chips. Fix with existing Permissions.list_effective_many(access: Permissions.access(person, :read)) and add a regression. No general findings. Reviewed PR 1 issues 1/2/4/8/9/12/13/19 and related chunk lifecycle/permission helpers. Shared Actions, DS reuse, migration reset guards, optimistic decisions and no tool exposure checked. Estimated review tokens: input 8000/output 250/total 8250; runtime metrics unavailable. Review phase complete; returning to implementation for the fix.

Validation findings: full precommit reported 85 failures. Most came from the default test DB retaining the early experimental chunks table without embedding; dedicated freshly migrated partition passed. Repairing that test-only schema via canonical Chunk.reset_table. Two FTS fresh-install fixture sites directly DROP chunks and now collide with real FK ownership; mechanically use Chunk.drop_table, preserving fresh-install scenario and every assertion. No test behavioral expectations changed. Local .venv links the already-installed main ZAQ environment (no packages installed). Other Python Pipeline tests remain unchanged. Existing browser result: 141 passed, 2 existing skips, 1 WebKit navigation timeout before an unchanged System Config test; Firefox executable absent. Gate remains open.

Review finding corrected: batch chip reads now use Permissions.list_effective_many with explicit :read access. Regression proved update-only grant leakage before fix and passes after. Scoped expanded run: 280/289 tests pass including all label, chunk, FTS and document-processor tests; 9 failures remain in unchanged Python conversion/pipeline tests (stub-like converted output for real fixtures; nonexistent-path error handling). No assertions weakened. mix q passes. Full precommit needs rerun after mechanical FTS cleanup and table component styling; independent coverage/review approval still pending.

Final scoped regression suite passes 446 tests (12 properties), including all labeling, API, Chunk, FTS, DocumentProcessor, BOLayout, Roles and ingestion LiveView tests. Migration rollback/reapply succeeds. Chromium manual inspection confirms catalog/form, shared editor, saved document chip. Screenshots /tmp/pr1-label-definition.png, /tmp/pr1-labels-catalog.png, /tmp/pr1-label-editor.png, /tmp/pr1-ingestion-labels.png. Full precommit rerun pending completion; unrelated Python fixture failures persist. Gate stays in progress for final validation, independent review and coverage.

Final precommit rerun completed with only pre-existing Python conversion/pipeline fixture/environment failures; label, chunk lifecycle, FTS fixture and document processor failures resolved. Final scoped suite: 446 passed (12 properties), migration roundtrip passed, mix q clean. Temporary Python environment link removed after validation. No final approval requested because full gate is not green; independent PR review and coverage remain pending. No commits or pushes.

User UX correction: replace Size column with Labels in ingestion list; show size beside file/folder name with smaller muted text. Reuses existing LabelChips and editor unchanged; no domain operations added. mix q passed. Final PR gate remains open as previously recorded.

UX feedback applied: filename underline scoped to name only; size uses body-sm tertiary text in parentheses. Shared chips expose hover/focus remove controls and compact + Add label on row/card hover or focus, always visible on touch. Removal reuses get_resource_labels and versioned edit_resource_labels Events with permission enforcement and manual exclusion. No new Action required; BO helper composes existing Actions. mix q passed. Existing final validation/E2E approval blockers remain.

UX correction: chip remove control now positioned absolutely at top-right with compact 16px circular surface, eliminating reserved inline space. CSS-only change; existing hover/focus/touch behavior retained. mix q passed.

Editor UX refinement per user: selected labels only in main two-column area (single column on narrow screens), explicit standard body/default and tertiary description colors, accent selected surface; + Add labels expandable searchable list of unassigned labels searches name/description case-insensitively. Removed unavailable automatic controls. Reused BOModal, DS text input/buttons/table checkbox; native details avoids new dropdown hook or component API. Search is local presentation state; persistence still existing Actions. Storybook updated. mix q and 6 focused tests passed, including new search/staging scenario; existing assertions preserved. Final UX/E2E approval and PR validation gates remain open.

User correction: search field now always visible as first control in label modal; removed collapsible Add labels summary. Available choices shown directly in two-column layout. mix q and all 4 editor tests passed.

Simplified editor per user: always-visible search acts as picker; only selected labels render outside results, two per row. Nonempty query reveals matching unselected name/description buttons directly below input; selection stages label and clears search/results. Existing editor tests receive mechanical search navigation updates preserving every prior assertion and scenario, with extra assertions for initial/results visibility and cleared query. Reuses existing toggle/save Events; no new domain operation. mix q passed after transient unrelated module availability compiler failure resolved on retry.

Label picker results now float in a fixed panel anchored to input, without modal layout shift or scroll-container clipping. Local LabelPicker hook repositions on LiveView updates, resize and scroll and cleans up listeners/observer. Existing SearchableSelect hook inspected: its trigger/hidden-input/filter contract does not match this always-visible server-filtered input; narrow presentation hook justified, no domain Action. Chromium isolated component inspection passed unchanged modal geometry, alignment, overflow and resize. Four existing editor tests passed; mix q and asset build passed.
